title: klayout-tools knowledge base entry
description: One published circuit design (topology, sizing strategy, layout idioms) that the LLM reasoning module can draw on. See kb/README.md for the sourcing rules that every entry must satisfy.

id.description: Stable slug; must match the entry's filename stem (kb/entries/<id>.json).

spec_class.description: What kind of spec this design serves (e.g. 'low-power PHY bias/reference').

pdk_portability.description: What changes / what's PDK-specific vs. portable about this design. Optional: omit or set null when not yet characterized.

primary_pdk.description: The PDK this entry was evaluated/designed against, e.g. 'sky130'.

notes.description: What is PDK-specific vs. portable to other PDKs.

sizing_approach.description: How device sizes/bias points were derived. Optional: omit or set null when not applicable.

layout_idioms.description: Layout techniques used, e.g. common-centroid matching, guard rings. Optional: omit, null, or empty when none apply yet.

source.description: Citation for the design. Must satisfy the open-sources-only rule in kb/README.md.

citation.description: Full citation: authors, title, venue/year, or repo URL + license.

url.description: Link to the source, if available. Optional: omit or set null when none exists.

license_or_openness.description: Why this source clears the open-sources-only bar. Optional: omit or set null only when self-evident from the citation.

notes.description: Free-form notes. Optional: omit or set null when there is nothing to add.

artifacts.description: Links this entry to a runnable artifact: a netlist/testbench under examples/ runnable via `klt sim`, and/or a GDS/OASIS layout runnable via `klt drc`. `klt kb validate` checks that these paths exist on disk. Optional: omit or set null when no runnable artifact exists yet for this entry.

netlist.description: Path, relative to the repository root, to a SPICE netlist/testbench (e.g. under examples/) runnable via `klt sim`.

layout.description: Path, relative to the repository root, to a GDS/OASIS layout runnable via `klt drc`.

notes.description: Free-form prose about the linked artifacts — e.g. how the drawn structure simplifies the entry's described idioms, or what the testbench does and does not cover. Prose only: never treated as a path by `klt kb validate`. Optional: omit or set null when there is nothing to add.

measured.description: Numeric figures (gain, phase, bias point, corner, ...) reproduced by running a checked-in testbench via `klt sim`, so `klt kb search --where` / `klt kb match` can filter on numbers instead of prose. `klt kb validate` checks that every figure's `testbench` path exists on disk, the same way it checks `artifacts.{netlist,layout}`. Optional: omit or set null when no reproducible measured figures exist yet for this entry.

pdk.description: PDK the figures below were measured against, e.g. 'sky130'.

corner.description: Named process/voltage/temperature corner the figures below were measured at, e.g. 'tt, 1.8V, 27C'. Free text -- record whatever the testbench's request.json actually swept/held fixed.

supply_v.description: Supply voltage the figures were measured at, when a single fixed nominal supply applies. Optional: omit or set null when the corner text above already captures it, or when multiple supplies are in play.

notes.description: Free-form prose caveat about the figures below -- e.g. that the testbench uses behavioral/ideal elements rather than PDK device models, so the numbers demonstrate a sizing relation rather than silicon accuracy. Prose only: never treated as a path by `klt kb validate`. Optional: omit or set null when there is nothing to add.

name.description: Figure name, e.g. av_db, cm_av_db, input_phase, vin_bias_v, gbw_hz, pm_deg, idd_a, vout_v, period_s. No fixed vocabulary -- name it after what it measures so `--where <name><op><value>` reads naturally.

value.description: The measured numeric value, in `unit` below.

analysis.description: SPICE analysis kind that produced this figure (e.g. 'op', 'tran', 'ac'). Optional: omit or set null when not meaningfully distinct from the testbench's own single analysis.

testbench.description: Path, relative to the repository root, to the `klt sim` request (or netlist, if no request.json exists) that reproduces this figure -- e.g. 'examples/kb/<id>/request.json'. `klt kb validate` checks this path exists on disk, the same way it checks artifacts.{netlist,layout}.
